passive_abilities.name: Assault Shield
passive_abilities.description: If this operative has a dominator maul & assault shield, it has a 3+ Save stat.

passive_abilities.name: Nuncio-aquila
passive_abilities.description: •	 Whenever an enemy operative is within 3" of your Nuncio-aquila marker (or this operative if your Nuncio-aquila marker isn’t in the killzone), your opponent must spend 1 additional AP for that enemy operative to perform the Pick Up Marker and mission actions. •	 Whenever determining control of a marker, treat the total APL stat of enemy operatives that contest it as 1 lower if at least one of those enemy operatives is within 3" of your Nuncio-aquila marker (or this operative if your Nuncio-aquila marker isn’t in the killzone). Note this isn’t a change to the APL stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.

passive_abilities.name: DEPLOY NUNCIO-AQUILA
passive_abilities.description: If your Nuncio-aquila marker isn’t in the killzone, place it within 6" horizontally of this operative; otherwise, move your Nuncio-aquila marker up to 6" horizontally. If this operative is removed from the killzone, remove your Nuncio-aquila marker from the killzone. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative. ARBITES PROCTOR-EXACTANT

passive_abilities.name: Medic!
passive_abilities.description: The first time during each turning point that another friendly EXACTION SQUAD  operative would be incapacitated while visible to and within 3" of this operative, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative is within control range of an enemy operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining and cannot be incapacitated for the remainder of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Dash action, but must end that move within this operative’s control range. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats until the end of their next activations respectively, and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends. You cannot use this rule if this operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.

unique_actions.name: MEDIKIT  (1AP)
unique_actions.description: Select one friendly EXACTION SQUAD  operative within this operative’s control range to regain up to 2D3 lost wounds. It cannot be an operative that the Medic! rule was used on during this turning point. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative. ARBITES CHIRURGANT

passive_abilities.name: Handler
passive_abilities.description: Whenever this operative is activated, you can activate a ready friendly EXACTION SQUAD  R-VR CYBER-MASTIFF operative at the same time. Complete their activations action by action in any order.

passive_abilities.name: Attack Pattern
passive_abilities.description: STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning point. Select two of the following attack patterns for a friendly EXACTION SQUAD  R-VR

passive_abilities.name: CYBER-MASTIFF operative to have for the battle
Aggressive
passive_abilities.description: Its melee weapons have the Relentless weapon rule.

passive_abilities.name: Swift
passive_abilities.description: Add 2" to its Move stat.

passive_abilities.name: Defensive
passive_abilities.description: Improve its Save stat by 1.

passive_abilities.name: R-VR COMMAND
passive_abilities.description: Select one friendly EXACTION SQUAD  R-VR CYBER-MASTIFF operative and change one of its attack patterns. ARBITES LEASHMASTER

passive_abilities.name: Beast
passive_abilities.description: This operative cannot perform any actions other than Apprehend, Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Guard, Reposition, Pick Up Marker and Place Marker. It cannot use any weapons that aren’t on its datacard.

passive_abilities.name: APPREHEND
passive_abilities.description: Select one enemy operative within this operative’s control range. Until that enemy operative is no longer within this operative’s control range, or until this operative performs this action again (whichever comes first), worsen the Hit stat of that enemy operative’s weapons by 1 (this isn’t cumulative with being injured); in addition, that enemy operative cannot perform the Fall Back action. This operative cannot perform this action unless an enemy operative is within its control range.

passive_abilities.name: Engendered Focus
passive_abilities.description: You can ignore any changes to this operative’s stats (including its weapons’ stats, but excluding its Save stat).

passive_abilities.name: Zealous Dedication
passive_abilities.description: Whenever an attack dice inflicts damage of 3 or more on this operative, roll one D6: on a 5+, subtract 1 from that inflicted damage.

passive_abilities.name: Castigator’s Arrest
passive_abilities.description: Whenever an enemy operative is within control range of this operative, if no other enemy operatives are within this operative’s control range, that enemy operative cannot perform the Fall Back action.

passive_abilities.name: Acute Focus
passive_abilities.description: Once during each of this operative’s activations, it can perform the Pick Up Marker, Place Marker, Veriscant or a mission action for 1 less AP.

unique_actions.name: VERISCANT  (1AP)
unique_actions.description: Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Until the start of this operative’s next activation, until it’s incapacitated or until it performs this action again (whichever comes first), whenever a friendly EXACTION SQUAD  operative is shooting against, fighting against or retaliating against that enemy operative, that friendly operative’s weapons have the Lethal 5+ and Severe weapon rules. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

passive_abilities.name: *Concealed Position
passive_abilities.description: This operative can only use this weapon the first time it’s performing the Shoot action during the battle.

unique_actions.name: OPTICS  (1AP)
unique_actions.description: Until the start of this operative’s next activation: •	 The concealed and stationary profiles of its executioner shotgun have the Lethal 5+ weapon rule. •	 Whenever it’s shooting with its executioner shotgun, enemy operatives cannot be obscured. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

passive_abilities.name: First in the Field
passive_abilities.description: STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning point. If this operative is wholly within your drop zone, it can immediately perform a free Reposition action.

unique_actions.name: SPOT  (1AP)
unique_actions.description: Select one enemy operative visible to and within 8" of this operative. Until the end of the turning point, whenever a friendly EXACTION SQUAD  operative is shooting that enemy operative, you can use this effect. If you do: •	 That friendly operative’s ranged weapons have the Seek Light weapon rule. •	 That enemy operative cannot be obscured. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

passive_abilities.name: Stubborn Subjugator
passive_abilities.description: You can ignore any changes to the Hit stat of this operative’s melee weapons.

passive_abilities.name: Close Quarters Vigilance
passive_abilities.description: This operative can perform the Shoot action (excluding Guard) while within control range of an enemy operative, but only if it hasn’t performed the Charge action during the activation, or if it’s a counteraction. Note this operative isn’t restricted from performing the Charge action after performing the Shoot action.

unique_actions.name: SIGNAL  (1AP)
unique_actions.description: SUPPORT. Select one other friendly EXACTION SQUAD  operative visible to this operative. Until the end of that operative’s next activation, add 1 to its APL stat. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.
